patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AWeber and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AWeber and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose AWeber only if your buying job matches “Creator- and SMB-focused email marketing with free forever, Lite/Plus tiers, and landing p” rather than Mailjet's shape. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than AWeber's shape. Workflow advantage: AWeber leans ecommerce-email; Mailjet leans marketing-automation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AWeber and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: AWeber is Creator- and SMB-focused email marketing with free forever, Lite/Plus tiers, and landing pages.; Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch)..
- Company-size focus: AWeber (micro, small-business) vs Mailjet (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: AWeber-leaning ecommerce-email vs Mailjet-leaning marketing-automation.
- Researched limits: AWeber — Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps; Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day).

Limitations — AWeber: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps; Lite caps lists, LPs, automations, users, and segments vs Plus; Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+.

Poor-fit cases: AWeber is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps · Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Avoid AWeber if you actually need Mailjet's motion (EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-vol)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
